title: Article 358 — Suspension of provisions of Article 19 during Emergencies

content.heading: Suspension of provisions of article 19 during emergencies
content.text: While a Proclamation of Emergency declaring that the security of India or any part of the territory thereof is threatened by war or by external aggression is in operation, nothing in Article 19 shall restrict the power of the State as defined in Part III to make any law or to take any executive action which the State would but for the provisions contained in that Part be competent to make or to take. The article does not apply in the same automatic way to an Emergency on the ground of armed rebellion. Read the official clauses.
